headline: After WWII the US quietly hired about 1,600 of Nazi Germany's scientists.
slides: As Germany fell, US teams raced the Soviets to find its scientists and engineers.
It started as Operation Overcast. Officers clipped a paperclip to the files of the ones they wanted.
President Truman approved it in a secret directive.
Some recruits' Nazi pasts were left out or played down so they could get in.
Wernher von Braun built the V-2, using concentration-camp labour. He went on to lead NASA's Marshall Space Flight Center.
?Wernher von Braun Marshall Space Flight Center
Paperclip scientists were central to the rockets that took Americans to the Moon.
